{{Kunark Era}} {{Disambig3|[[Sacrifice (item)]]}} {{Spellpage| | spellname = Sacrifice | spellicon = G | description = Consumes a willing target's soul and binds it within an [[Essence Emerald]]. Players (Level 46-59) killed in this manner cannot be resurrected. Consumes an [[emerald]] when cast. You cannot sacrifice yourself.

A player at maximum XP (100% into 60) who de-levels to 59 can be sacrificed seven times and still re-gain level 60 by receiving 90%+ resurrections on their other corpses.
